title: The Vulture Tree
text: A dead tree sags with dozens of vultures, hunched and patient. Beneath it, in the shade, the thing they are waiting on is still breathing. It is hard to tell what it is, or what it was.

options.label: The healer goes to see what is still breathing, before the birds decide.

outcomes.text: It is a wounded traveler, who pays in thanks and a map.

options.label: Leave it to the birds; whatever it is, it is beyond saving.

outcomes.text: The birds lift as you pass and settle behind you. The breathing stops.

options.label: Scare the vultures off so it may die in peace.
